lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 high-luminance circular clusters are visible on the mid-to-upper lateral flank, arranged in three visible horizontal rows forming a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the primary lateral blobs to form a grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs, which contrast with the larger, more uniformly spaced spots on the main lateral flank.
